brief.aim: The table holds eight discrete design parameters (X1-X8) plus two co-recorded continuous energy loads (Y1 heating, Y2 cooling) per building configuration, so the evident aim is joint prediction of both loads, making multioutput_regression appropriate. No column is an identifier, a post-outcome measurement, or a transform of a target, and there is no subject or chronology structure to constrain partitioning.
brief.repeated_subjects: None; each row is a distinct design configuration with no subject or device repeated across rows
brief.unit: One simulated building configuration (row = combination of eight architectural/glazing design parameters)
